source: States: 'INDIA/INDIA_STATES.geojson'; Telangana districts: 'STATES/TELANGANA/TELANGANA_DISTRICTS.geojson' from datta07/INDIAN-SHAPEFILES (https://github.com/datta07/INDIAN-SHAPEFILES), MIT License. Boundaries follow the Survey of India / Government of India depiction (J&K and Ladakh UTs incl. PoK, Gilgit-Baltistan and Aksai Chin). Projected to Web Mercator, Douglas-Peucker simplified (0.3 px, shared-border preserving), coords rounded to 0.1 px. Daman & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli merged (2020 UT). Telangana district polygons are the 33-district (2019) configuration; 'Warangal Urban'/'Warangal Rural' were renamed Hanumakonda/Warangal in 2021 with minor mandal transfers not reflected here.
formula: lonRad = lon*PI/180; latRad = lat*PI/180; x = k*lonRad + tx; y = -k*ln(tan(PI/4 + latRad/2)) + ty  (Web Mercator, SVG user units)
